name: battleground
description: A portable, Ludus-compatible cyber range simulator with a web UI

scripts.build: npm run build -w @battleground/web && npm run build -w @battleground/server
scripts.typecheck: tsc -p packages/core --noEmit && tsc -p packages/server --noEmit && tsc -p packages/web --noEmit
scripts.check: npm run typecheck && npm run test
